neighbours.label: Plural pronoun for a romantic couple right after the partner is introduced by a conjunction (his wife, Lucy, and | their; met him and | they started dating); a group of coworkers or companies in the same frame stays quiet
fire: Paul lives in Leeds with his wife, Sara, and their two young sons.
She met him at a wedding and they got engaged a year later.

Helen runs the farm with her husband, Ian, and their teenage daughter.
He met her on a train and they married within six months.
Omar shares the house with his fiancée and their elderly dog.
